propositions: not_a_bug close without --reason and without a replacement link currently routes to the completion verifier, which cannot pass because it demands proof a defect was fixed when the RCA establishes no defect existed
close_disposition.verdict() returns None for not_a_bug (no replacement found) and falls through to full completion verification instead of minting a deterministic disposition
not_a_bug and escalated must be made REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so --reason is mandatory at write time; a live replacement link in REPLACEMENT_SATISFIES_REASON_CLASSES short-circuits the requirement
write-side refusal via txn.close_class_refusal must name both available resolution paths (replacement link or --reason) and prevent any fall-through to the completion verifier
disposition verdicts for not_a_bug and escalated must be signed and stored deterministically from (class, close_reason) tuples without invoking an LLM or replacement lookup
